meta.description:
An abandoned Soviet-era research bunker buried deep underground, organized around a narrow service corridor and sealed laboratories. Flickering fluorescent tubes, rusted control
    panels, stained concrete, and obsolete scientific equipment give the facility a cold, decaying character.
